list: The official 55 trophies, checked 2026-11-18 against PowerPyx and GTABase, whose lists agree.
xbox: Same 55 achievements on Xbox Series X|S, 1,000 Gamerscore in total; the platinum is a 0G Mythic achievement on Xbox.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the sum of everything else in this guide: earn the other fifty-four trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Nothing here needs the internet, a second playthrough or a difficulty setting, so the road is long but straightforward. Work through the story first, then the hundred-percent checklist, then the Strangers and Freaks strands and whatever small trophies remain. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about two hundred hours and a difficulty of four out of ten, since most of the time goes to the checklist. Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter, keep cheats off, and tick trophies off in the tracker as you earn them.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the first story trophy and it cannot be missed: play Gone Fishing, the mission that opens Chapter 1, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is a good moment to learn the basics the rest of the game builds on: driving, shooting and moving between Jason and Lucia when the story asks. If you are following this guide from the start, earn it naturally and move on; the tracker will mark it and the roadmap's first stage begins here. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as an automatic story trophy, hidden until earned, worth five Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 and this trophy unlocks as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins, so it is automatic and cannot be missed. Play every mission in order and do the optional tasks as they appear, since those feed the hundred-percent checklist later and there is no mission replay. Chapter 1 also holds the one thing in the whole game that can be missed, the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude, so do that the morning after Down to Earth and keep a Chapter 1 save. Otherwise just enjoy the opening: meet the main characters, learn Leonida's map and bank your first progress. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth twenty Gamerscore.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 and this trophy pops as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City, so it is automatic and cannot be missed. Chapter 2 is where the map opens up and the side systems arrive: fishing with Cal, the Mud Club, and the first stranger strands, so take the time to try them while the story is still short. Keep scanning vehicles with WAiNK and studying animals with binoculars as you travel, since both feed the hundred-percent checklist and are easier started early than finished late. Save at the end of the chapter. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth twenty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 and this trophy unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, so it is automatic and cannot be missed. Chapter 3 is a busy one: bank jobs open after Credit Check, the Key Cloner arrives, and several side characters hand out their quest lines, so follow each new contact as it appears rather than leaving them all for after the story. Keep the save plan going, one slot at the end of each chapter, and keep cheats off, since a cheat disables trophies and saving. By now the tracker should show a healthy row of story trophies. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth twenty Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 and this trophy pops when its final mission ends, so it is automatic and cannot be missed. Chapter 4 holds some of the biggest set pieces in the story, including the VCIA takedown and the bank vaults, so play it through in order and let the side content wait until the credits if you are short on time. Nothing in this chapter locks you out of anything later: free roam continues after the story and every collectible stays available. Keep a save at the chapter's end, then step into the final chapter with the checklist in mind. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth twenty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold trophy unlocks, so it is automatic and cannot be missed. Play the last mission in Chapter 5 to its end and the credits roll; free roam continues afterwards, so nothing else depends on how you play it. Before the finale, it is worth doing the Chapter 1 balcony meditation if you have not already, since that is the only thing in the game that can pass you by. After the credits the hundred-percent checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and the long second stage of the roadmap begins. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden gold story trophy worth fifty Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 and this trophy pops when the mission ends, so it is automatic and cannot be missed. It is a story mission like the others, with no special requirement and no choice that changes the outcome, so just follow the mission markers and finish it. Breakfast Run is also a good early chance to practise the driving and shooting the later chapters demand, and to get used to switching between Jason and Lucia. There is nothing to prepare beforehand and nothing to clean up afterwards. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth ten Gamerscore on Xbox, one of the twelve story trophies that unlock automatically.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 and this trophy pops when the heist ends, so it is automatic and cannot be missed. It is one of the bigger story missions, so take the time to stock up on armour and ammunition before you start, and follow the plan the mission lays out rather than improvising. The heist also opens up the bank-job systems that feed the hundred-percent checklist, so the missions after it matter as much as the trophy itself. There is no missable step inside it and no choice that locks anything away. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth twenty-five Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play Child's Play in Chapter 4 and this trophy pops when the mission ends, so it is automatic and cannot be missed. Like the other story missions it has no special requirement: follow the markers, finish the mission, and move on. Chapter 4 is long, so it helps to keep the save plan going and to do the optional tasks as they appear, since they feed the hundred-percent checklist and there is no mission replay. Nothing in Child's Play can be failed in a way that locks the trophy away; retrying a failed mission still counts. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth fifteen Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play Headliners in Chapter 4 and this trophy pops when the mission ends, so it is automatic and cannot be missed. It is a story mission with no special requirement and no hidden step, so follow the markers and finish it like any other. Headliners sits late in Chapter 4, so by the time you reach it you will have most of the story trophies already, and the tracker will show how close the platinum is getting. Keep a save at the end of the chapter and keep cheats off. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth fifteen Gamerscore on Xbox, one of the twelve automatic story trophies.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 and this trophy pops when the mission ends, so it is automatic and cannot be missed. It is a story mission with no special requirement, so follow the markers, finish the takedown, and move on to the next mission. The VCIA airport area is also worth remembering for later, since the Catch Me If You Can trophy needs a jet stolen from its boarding gates, though that is a separate free-roam task and not part of this mission. Keep the save plan going and keep cheats off. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth twenty-five Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 and this trophy pops when the mission ends, so it is automatic and cannot be missed. It is one of the final story missions, so expect a long fight and stock up on armour, ammunition and snacks before you start. There is no special requirement and no choice that changes the outcome, so follow the mission through to its end. After it, only the final mission stands between you and the credits, and then the hundred-percent checklist opens. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth twenty-five Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.hint: Hardest trophy, about 100 hours of cleanup
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is the hardest in the game and the reason the platinum takes about two hundred hours: attain one hundred percent completion on the checklist that appears after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Work the thirty-five requirements in the Checklist tab of this guide, from the story and gang operations to the partial counts for vehicles, animals, meditations, challenges, stunts, WAiNK scans, flamingos, card sets and stick-ups. Progress made before the credits already counts, and nothing on the list is missable, so start early and chip away. PowerPyx calls it roughly sixty percent of true completion, and both PowerPyx and GTABase list it as worth one hundred Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any two hundred and fifty of the three hundred and ninety-seven stunts in Leonida: one hundred and thirty jumps, two hundred and two flights under bridges, forty knife flights and twenty-five base jumps. Under-bridge flights are the fastest to farm, since bridges are everywhere and each one counts once you fly cleanly beneath it. The hundred-percent checklist wants three hundred stunts, so keep going past this trophy rather than stopping at two hundred and fifty. Track your count under Progress and use a fast plane or helicopter for the flights. PowerPyx counts three hundred and ninety-seven stunts in total, and both PowerPyx and GTABase list this silver trophy as worth forty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.hint: Easy, one session of trying things
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball by scoring one basket, an arcade game, winning a race, and landing a stunt. None of them needs to be mastered or repeated, so one quick try of each is enough, and most of them come naturally while you play the story and the side content. Check Progress, Activities to see which types are still missing, then knock them out in a single free-roam session. Hunting needs Bret's introduction first, and the arcade games are on the television at home and on cabinets around Leonida. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth twenty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold at all forty-two shooting-range challenges across the twelve ranges in Leonida. Each range holds a few challenges, so work through them range by range and use the weapon each challenge asks for. Ranges also raise Focus, which helps with the Gunslinger trophy, so the time spent here pays twice. Gold needs clean, fast shooting, so practise a challenge a few times before chasing the medal, and use the range's own targets rather than free-roam shooting. The hundred-percent checklist wants all forty-two golds too, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this silver trophy as worth forty Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the fourteen Top Fun locations around Leonida. Each location hosts its own race, so visit all fourteen and win each one; a loss does not lock anything, so retry until it clicks. Drone races are short and technical, so learn each course's turns before pushing for speed, and use the drone's boost on the straights. The hundred-percent checklist wants all forty-two drone races, so finish every race at each spot while you are there rather than coming back later. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth fifteen Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win twenty different races out of the forty available in Leonida. Repeating the same race does not count, so you need twenty distinct wins across the race types: street, off-road, boat and air races all count toward the total. Pick the races that suit your best vehicle, learn their routes, and work through the list one at a time. Races also feed the activity counts, so they pair well with the other driving trophies. Check your progress under the race menus to see which ones you have already won. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth twenty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal during Feng Shui in Chapter 1, then follow his fishing quests when he texts you a purple-marked spot on the map. Fish at each spot he sends, catch what he asks for, and keep going until he challenges you to a fishing contest of his own. Beat Cal in that challenge and the trophy pops. Fishing is slow and patient work, so bring the right bait for the spot and watch the line rather than rushing. The quests arrive by text over the course of the game, so answer them as they come. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth ten Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.hint: Easy, one arcade game to finish
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game end to end. Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash Three and Time Jackers Rewind are on the television at home, while Bang For Your Buck sits on arcade cabinets around Leonida, so pick whichever game suits you best. Each game is short once you learn its rules, so a few tries are usually enough to see one through to its ending. Arcade games also count toward the nine activity types for Master of None, so this trophy pairs naturally with that one. There is no missable step and no time pressure. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth ten Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.hint: Lucia only, five quests in order
trophies.guide: Lucia only. In Chapter 3 Andy calls, then texts an address in Belville, and his quest line begins. Do his five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass, finishing each before the next appears. The quests are short errands around Vice City, so follow the markers and complete them as they arrive. They stay available after the story, so there is no rush and nothing is missable. The final quest ends the strand and the trophy pops. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth fifteen Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton marks treasure dives with purple chest icons after Island Dreams in Chapter 1. Dive at each marker, use the metal detector to dig up the chest, and bring the haul back to him. Clear seven shipwrecks in total to finish his strand. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts again later, so the strand is not missable and you can pick it up whenever his messages resume. Diving needs patience and a careful eye for the detector's signals, so work the markers one at a time. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth fifteen Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.hint: Five jobs at the Mud Club
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, head to the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County and meet Billy. Do his five jobs in order, ending with Hometown Heroes, following the markers for each one. The jobs are driving-heavy and set around the mud club's territory, so a sturdy off-road vehicle helps. The muddy back roads punish low cars, so bring something with clearance and keep it fuelled between jobs. They stay available after the story, so there is no rush and nothing is missable. Finish the last job and the trophy pops, closing Billy's strand. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth fifteen Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight stranger strands that count toward this trophy: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed counters, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. Watch the trophy's own progress counter in the game to see which strands are ticking it upward, and do not waste time on the ones that do not. None of the eight are needed for one hundred percent completion, so treat this as a side project for after the story. The strands are scattered across Leonida, so work them in batches by region. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this silver trophy as worth thirty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 you get the Key Cloner. Deliver the sixteen sports cars on Randy's wish list to his garage in west Vice City, scanning cars with WAiNK to check them against the list before you steal them. Hotel driveways around Vice Beach are good hunting grounds for the rare models, and the list tells you exactly which cars still elude you. The strand stays available after the story, so there is no rush and nothing is missable. Deliver the last car and the trophy pops. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth twenty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, destroy the purple-marked synthetic labs around Vice City until Tyrone's last job, Shut Down the Labs, appears. The labs are marked on the map, so work through them one at a time with explosives and a fast getaway vehicle, since the police respond quickly. Each lab is a small compound with guards, so scout it first, plant your explosives, and leave before the blast draws a crowd. The strand stays available after the story, so there is no rush and nothing is missable. Finish the final job and the trophy pops. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden story trophy worth fifteen Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.hint: Chapter 1 balcony meditation — do it early
trophies.guide: Meditate at all eighteen spots across ten locations in Leonida; doing a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, so bring both when you can. Track your count under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. Possibly missable: the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It adds one to the counter, is not marked as a meditation spot, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save. The last spot needs both characters together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. One hundred percent needs only fifteen of eighteen. PowerPyx and GTABase both confirm these facts.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.hint: Jason only, unconfirmed which animal pops it
trophies.guide: Jason only. After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, Bret texts you about hunting, starting with Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Follow his messages to the purple-marked target decks, hunt the animal each deck names, and bring it back to him. Which animal pops the trophy is still unconfirmed, so treat every deck as progress and keep hunting until it unlocks. The hundred-percent checklist needs all fifteen target decks anyway, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. Hunting needs patience, a good rifle and a quiet approach. PowerPyx lists this trophy as unconfirmed, and both PowerPyx and GTABase list it as a hidden bronze worth fifteen Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three of the eighteen collectible card sets, four hundred and eighty cards in total across Leonida. Cards hide in shops, houses, vehicles and out in the open, so pick three sets and hunt their cards systematically rather than grabbing at random. Progress, Collections shows each set and which cards are still missing, so use it as your checklist. The hundred-percent list wants fifteen of eighteen sets, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing the platinum. Three sets is the trophy; fifteen is the checklist. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this silver trophy as worth thirty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any one hundred WAiNK spots with the phone app: hold Up, then R1 or RB, and point at the spot. The spots are thirty-one landmarks, thirty-five curiosities, twenty-three sculptures and the No Flusher tags, scattered across Leonida. Scan as you travel rather than hunting them all at once, since most of them sit beside places the story and side content visit anyway. The phone app shows what you have scanned, so check it when you are unsure what is left. One hundred scans is the trophy; the checklist wants the same hundred. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this silver trophy as worth thirty Gamerscore.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any fifty of the eighty challenges in the game, and Progress, Challenges ticks each finished one. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying, swimming and more, so play naturally and they pile up on their own. One hundred percent needs seventy, so this trophy comes along the way to the platinum and needs no special farming. If you want to push it early, pick the short challenges first, like the driving and shooting ones, and leave the long grinds for later. There is nothing missable here and no order to follow. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth five Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.hint: Medium, escape the red heat zone
trophies.guide: Once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner, build a four-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters, so head there once the stars hit four. Bank vault robberies always give four stars, so the trophy often pops there on its own. Make sure your partner is with you when the stars rise, or the attempt does not count. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth twenty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.hint: Medium, three shops in one wanted run
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while still wanted, shown by the flashing red and blue lights. Go in armoured, with sticky bombs and healing items, and move fast between shops. The three jewellery stores in north Vice City are close together, which makes the run much easier than three scattered shops. It can take about thirty seconds to pop after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth. Losing the wanted level between shops breaks the chain, so keep the heat on until all three are done. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth twenty Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.hint: Easy, scan traffic from the roadside
trophies.guide: Scan one hundred different vehicles with the WAiNK phone app; you do not need to drive them, only scan them. Stand by a busy road and scan the passing traffic, since variety comes to you that way, and check the app to see which models are still missing. One hundred percent needs two hundred base models, so keep scanning long after this trophy pops, and scan every new vehicle you meet. Rare and expensive cars count just like common ones, so variety matters more than value. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth twenty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.hint: Skilful, five kills in one Focus
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies in one Combat Focus, activated by clicking both sticks while aiming. Fill Focus first by eating, drinking and washing up, and Adrenaline stretches it further, so prepare before the fight. Use an assault rifle and pick gang-operation thugs as targets, since cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count toward the five. Start Focus with a group clustered together, and keep firing until the fifth drops. Time slows while Focus runs, so line up each shot instead of spraying. The shooting ranges help you practise, and Focus rises there too. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth ten Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.hint: Medium, steal a jet from gates E3 or E4
trophies.guide: At VCIA airport, steal a big passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence, use the door by the stairs, back the jet out, take off and fly about one kilometre from the airport. Keep the jet level after takeoff, since a steep climb stalls it. The police will chase you, so climb fast and put distance between yourself and the runways. A small plane does not count, and neither does a jet taken from the open airfield. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden bronze trophy worth ten Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.hint: Medium, steal a Rhino at Mile Zero
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the south-west island of Mariana County, where the tanks sit at the south end of the base. Drive in fast, grab a tank and shoot enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. The base is heavily guarded, so expect soldiers and a wanted level the moment you enter, and use the tank's armour to shrug off the response. You do not need to leave the base with it; the kills inside are what count. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden bronze trophy worth ten Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.hint: Medium, use the Snap Gun on the back door
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 you have the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewellery store's locked back door, since kicking it in trips the alarm, then find the safe code in the back room and empty the safe unseen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds works well for this, with a clear route from the back door to the safe. Move slowly, watch the staff, and leave the way you came without being spotted. A clean run pops the trophy; a detected one does not, so retry if the alarm sounds. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth ten Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.hint: Hard, five vaults with four-star escapes
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open with That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4. Follow a security van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open, and hand a bag to your partner, since one person cannot carry it all. Vaults always give four stars, so leave on a fast bike and then switch vehicles to shake the police. Rob any five of the eight vaults for this trophy; one hundred percent needs all eight, so keep going. Each vault is a full job, so plan the escape before you walk in. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this silver trophy as worth forty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.hint: Easy, a vault robbery counts too
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape. Robbing a bank vault counts, as long as you escape the heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray afterwards. Earlier in the game, box in an armoured truck, stick a bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away with the cash. Trucks roam the highways, so watch for them while driving and strike when the road is clear. The escape matters as much as the robbery: lose the wanted level or reach a spray shop to finish it. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth ten Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.hint: Easy, fly over every dark patch
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida by visiting every part of it. A plane is fastest: fly over every dark patch until nothing is left, working region by region so you do not miss a corner. The map fills in as you travel, so much of it comes free from the story and side content, and only the remote corners need a dedicated flight. Land and explore on foot where the plane cannot show you the ground clearly. There is nothing missable here and no order to follow. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth twenty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation, shown by yellow icons, from each of the nine gangs in Leonida. Progress, Gangs keeps count of which gangs you have hit, so check it before you plan a run. Each operation is a small robbery with its own guards and loot, so go in prepared and leave fast. One hundred percent needs all thirty-nine operations cleared, so this trophy is the first step on a much longer road. Work gang by gang rather than at random, and the counter will climb steadily. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth twenty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact steps are unconfirmed: GTABase lists this trophy as not yet confirmed, so treat any specific bar claim with care and do not trust a single source. What is known is the description itself, a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so try the beachfront bars and cafes with terraces facing the sea, order a cocktail, and see if it pops. If it does not, move on and come back later, since launch-era details are still being pinned down. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag this one as unconfirmed, and it is a hidden bronze worth five Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the window. You need the Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 first, or the car will not start. GTABase notes the exact steps are not yet confirmed, while PowerPyx names this Banshee method, so treat the details as the best current report rather than settled fact. Approach the showroom, take the Banshee, and drive through the glass in classic style. If it does not pop, retry after the story. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden bronze worth five Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2, take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway, bringing sticky bombs for the safe. It pops once you lose the police afterwards, so plan your escape before you start looting. You do not need all three in one visit, so you can take them across several trips if the heat gets too heavy. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden bronze trophy worth five Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out at fitness clubs together, since training one trains the other, or work out at home after the story when the gyms are quiet. Strength rises with regular sessions, so make the gym part of your routine between missions rather than a single marathon. Eating well and resting help the gains stick, and the stat screen shows both characters' progress. Once both bars are full at the same moment, the trophy pops. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden bronze trophy worth five Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform five hundred actions that change your Criminal Profile, and turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI to watch the count climb. Most players get it without trying, since nearly everything you do in Leonida shifts the profile one way or another: crimes, kindnesses, driving, spending and more. Do not push to Irredeemable, since that rank is permanent and locks you out of the gentler profile states. Just play normally, check the count now and then, and let it arrive on its own. PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as a hidden bronze trophy worth five Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact steps are unconfirmed: PowerPyx believes it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, but that is not confirmed, so treat any specific claim with care. What is known is only the description and the community's best guess, so try returning to the Payday Loans store after the Prologue and see whether a second visit triggers it. If nothing happens, leave it and come back later, since launch-era details are still being pinned down by the guide sites. PowerPyx lists this trophy as unconfirmed, and it is a hidden bronze worth five Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.hint: Unconfirmed, believed to be a UFO thread
trophies.guide: Something strange. The exact steps are unconfirmed: PowerPyx believes it is tied to a UFO questline, but that is not confirmed, so treat any specific claim with care. If a UFO thread exists in Leonida, it will likely surface through strange sightings and stranger messages, so keep an eye out for anything odd in the skies and follow up on it. Until the guide sites pin it down, the honest advice is to play through the game and check back for updates. PowerPyx lists this trophy as unconfirmed, and it is a hidden bronze worth five Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.hint: Unconfirmed, try kicking from a motorcycle
trophies.guide: Knock people down with a melee attack from a vehicle, a melee drive-by. The exact steps are unconfirmed: PowerPyx believes it is kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle, but that is not confirmed, so treat the method as the best current guess. Try it on a motorcycle, riding close to enemies and kicking as you pass, and see whether the trophy pops. A car may work too, but the motorcycle is the reported method. If it does not pop after several tries, leave it and check back later. PowerPyx lists this trophy as unconfirmed, and it is a hidden bronze worth five Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After Credit Check in Chapter 3 you have the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays best, so make him your regular buyer. It is a running total of two hundred and fifty thousand dollars, and the hundred-percent robberies get you most of the way there without extra farming. Keep robbing and fencing as you play, and the total climbs steadily. The trophy pops the moment the total crosses the line. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth twenty Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.hint: Running total, guns and car mods are fastest
trophies.guide: Spend one hundred thousand dollars across every kind of shop in Leonida, as a running total. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest, so buy the weapons and upgrades you actually want and let the total climb on its own. Clothes, food and smaller purchases all count too, so there is no need to waste money on things you will never use. Check your spending under the stats screens if you want to see how close you are. It pops once the total crosses one hundred thousand. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth fifteen Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the eight garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, after Daily Driver in Chapter 2, for about one hundred and sixty thousand dollars in total. The four garages the story gives you do not count, so only the eight you buy yourself tick the counter. Open the Real Estate app, find each garage listing, and buy them one at a time as your money allows. Each garage also gives you somewhere to store vehicles, so they are useful as well as collectible. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth fifteen Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.hint: Ten registrations at the Port Gellhorn garage
trophies.guide: After Moses' Chapter 2 mission you have the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his Port Gellhorn garage, respray and register them there. At first he only takes cars without trackers, but from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones too, so the pool of usable cars grows. Steal from quiet streets and hotel car parks rather than busy roads, where the police notice faster and the car may already be wanted. Use cheap cars and keep garage space free, since each registration takes a slot. Register ten vehicles in total and the trophy pops. PowerPyx and GTABase both list this bronze trophy as worth fifteen Gamerscore on Xbox.
